# cdnpro_hostname (Data Source)

Reports which property version currently serves a hostname in production and staging. The API returns an empty result rather than an error for an unknown hostname; `found` is false in that case and a warning is emitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cdnpro_hostname" "check" {
  hostname = "www.example.com"
}

output "production_property_version" {
  value = data.cdnpro_hostname.check.found ? data.cdnpro_hostname.check.property_in_production.version : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String)

### Read-Only

- `found` (Boolean) Whether the hostname is deployed to at least one environment.
- `property_in_production` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_in_production))
- `property_in_staging` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_in_staging))
